description: This file is a PHP script that interacts with the Redmine API to retrieve and create issues. It sets up multiple server configurations, fetches specific issues, and adds new issues via XML.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class that provides methods to interact with the Redmine API, including fetching projects/issues and adding issues via XML.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects from Redmine.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific issue by issue number.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine from a SimpleXMLElement object.
